# Third-party browser library

`markdown-it.umd.min.js` is the browser bundle of markdown-it 15.0.3, downloaded from the official npm package with its published SHA-512 integrity verified.

- Project and documentation: https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/markdown-it/15.0.3
- License: MIT; see `markdown-it.LICENSE.txt`.

The library is served locally with the website. No npm installation or build step is required to preview or publish the site.
